description: This file defines the LDAPSyncService class, responsible for synchronizing LDAP user data with the local system. It handles fetching LDAP entries, creating or updating system users, and managing LDAP-related configurations and operations within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

classes.name: LDAPSyncService
classes.description: Service class responsible for synchronizing LDAP users with the local HR system, including fetching LDAP entries, creating or updating users, and managing LDAP settings.

methods.name: getLDAPDao
methods.description: Returns the LDAPDao instance used for LDAP data operations.

methods.name: getLDAPService
methods.description: Initializes and returns the LDAPService instance, binding it with credentials based on LDAP settings.

methods.name: getLDAPSetting
methods.description: Retrieves the LDAP configuration settings; throws an exception if not configured.

methods.name: getEmpNumbersWhoHaveManyUsers
methods.description: Fetches employee numbers associated with multiple system users.

methods.name: fetchAllLDAPUsers
methods.description: Fetches all LDAP users from the LDAP server, handling duplicates and failures, and returns a collection.

methods.name: getHashOfLDAPUser
methods.description: Generates an MD5 hash for an LDAP user object to detect changes.

methods.name: createSystemUsers
methods.description: Creates or updates local system users based on LDAP user data, managing user and employee records.

methods.name: trySaveEmployee
methods.description: Attempts to save employee data and dispatches an event; returns the employee or null if failed.

methods.name: warnMultiUserEmployee
methods.description: Logs a warning if an employee has multiple associated users.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Persists employee data after validation of unique email and employee ID.

methods.name: filterLDAPAuthProvider
methods.description: Filters through user authentication providers to find LDAP type.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Main method to synchronize LDAP users with system data, transactionally handling fetch, create/update, and cleanup.

methods.name: fetchEntryCollections
methods.description: Fetches LDAP entry collections based on LDAP settings, with caching.

methods.name: fetchEntryCollection
methods.description: Fetches LDAP entries for a specific lookup setting, with cache support.

methods.name: prepareLDAPUserFromEntry
methods.description: Creates an LDAPUser DTO from an LDAP Entry, extracting attributes based on configuration.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Helper to extract a single attribute value from an LDAP Entry.

methods.name: getSearchAttributes
methods.description: Generates the list of LDAP attributes to search for based on settings.

methods.name: deleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServer
methods.description: Deletes local users that are no longer present in LDAP.
